"""Image-space freezing timelapse; no scene model or external resources."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter, map_coordinates
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
S = 4
W, H = 256, 144
rng = np.random.default_rng(9147)
base8 = np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
base = np.array(Image.fromarray(base8).resize((W*S,H*S),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(np.float32)
y,x = np.mgrid[:H*S,:W*S].astype(np.float32)
x=(x+.5)/S; y=(y+.5)/S

def smooth(a,b,v):
    t=np.clip((v-a)/(b-a),0,1)
    return t*t*(3-2*t)

def noise(nx,ny):
    a=rng.normal(size=(ny,nx)).astype(np.float32)
    im=Image.fromarray(a,'F').resize((W*S,H*S),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
    n=np.asarray(im).copy()
    return (n-n.mean())/(n.std()+1e-8)

ncoarse=noise(19,13)
medium=noise(90,65)
fine=noise(430,240)
cloud=noise(36,25)
striations=noise(95,17)
# The profile follows the original photographed inner glass walls.
left=93.8 + .054*np.clip(y-54,0,55)
right=166.9 - .080*np.clip(y-54,0,55)
edge=np.minimum(x-left,right-x)
wall=smooth(-.3,.65,edge)
bottom=108.0+4.3*np.sqrt(np.clip(1-((x-130.2)/33.4)**2,0,1))
bottommask=1-smooth(bottom-.65,bottom+.50,y)

# Fine refractive markings in the ice, constructed as image-space strokes.
bright_im=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0)
dark_im=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0)
bright=ImageDraw.Draw(bright_im); dark=ImageDraw.Draw(dark_im)
def trace(points,val,width=.22):
    p=[(round(a*S),round(b*S)) for a,b in points]
    bright.line(p, fill=int(val),width=max(1,round(width*S)))
    dark.line([(a+1,b+1) for a,b in p],fill=int(val*.63),width=max(1,round(width*S)))

# Side-originated, feathery needles. Small amounts of contrast retain refraction.
for k in range(125):
    side=rng.choice([-1,1]); sy=rng.uniform(58,107)
    sx=(94.9+.057*(sy-54)) if side==-1 else (165.7-.08*(sy-54))
    length=rng.uniform(3.5,19)
    theta=rng.uniform(-.95,.95)+(0 if side==-1 else np.pi)
    count=9
    steps=np.linspace(0,length,count)
    pts=[]
    for j,d in enumerate(steps):
        pts.append((sx+d*np.cos(theta)+.28*np.sin(j*1.7), sy+d*np.sin(theta)+.30*np.cos(j*1.4)))
    strength=rng.uniform(28,92)
    trace(pts,strength,.18)
    for j in range(2,8):
        bx,by=pts[j]; bl=rng.uniform(1.1,3.6)*(1-j/12)
        ang=theta+rng.choice([-1,1])*rng.uniform(.55,1.15)
        trace([(bx,by),(bx+bl*np.cos(ang),by+bl*np.sin(ang))],strength*.7,.15)
# Longer wisps and air-lined boundaries, mostly nearly vertical.
for k in range(38):
    sx=rng.uniform(99,161); sy=rng.uniform(64,103)
    length=rng.uniform(2,14)
    pts=[(sx+.6*np.sin(j*.7+k)+j*rng.uniform(-.03,.03),sy+j*length/10) for j in range(11)]
    trace(pts,rng.uniform(20,57),.20)
veins=np.asarray(bright_im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.45)),dtype=np.float32)/255
vein_dark=np.asarray(dark_im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.6)),dtype=np.float32)/255

# Crystal texture on the horizontal water surface; hairline faults, not a snow cap.
top_im=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0); topdraw=ImageDraw.Draw(top_im)
for k in range(48):
    ax=rng.uniform(97,164); ay=rng.uniform(48,59)
    le=rng.uniform(2,12); angle=rng.uniform(-np.pi,np.pi)
    pts=[(int((ax+d*np.cos(angle))*S),int((ay+d*.22*np.sin(angle)+.12*np.sin(d*2))*S)) for d in np.linspace(0,le,12)]
    topdraw.line(pts,fill=int(rng.uniform(32,130)),width=1)
surf_vein=np.array(top_im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.38)),dtype=np.float32)/255

# Stable tiny trapped bubbles. Later they are buried by the cloudy core.
bubble_im=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0); bd=ImageDraw.Draw(bubble_im)
for k in range(175):
    bx=rng.uniform(98,163); by=rng.uniform(59,109)
    r=rng.uniform(.09,.4)
    bd.ellipse(((bx-r)*S,(by-r)*S,(bx+r)*S,(by+r)*S),fill=int(rng.uniform(30,150)))
bubbles=np.asarray(bubble_im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.4)),dtype=np.float32)/255

# Crystalline skin on the outside of the glass, strongest near the wet cold wall.
frost_noise=.56*medium+.24*fine+.2*cloud
frost_grain=np.clip((frost_noise-.05)/2,0,1)
front_frost=(.14+.86*np.exp(-((x-99)/5.5)**2)+.62*np.exp(-((x-160)/5)**2))
frost_body=smooth(91.5,93,x)*(1-smooth(166.5,168.5,x))*smooth(51,56,y)*(1-smooth(113,118,y))
# Original edge highlights are retained through an image-derived mask.
luma=base.mean(axis=2)
highlight=smooth(179,239,luma)
specular_band=np.exp(-((x-(left+1.0))/1.05)**2)+.65*np.exp(-((x-(right-1))/1.3)**2)
preserve=np.clip(specular_band*highlight*.40,0,.48)

frames=[base8.copy()]
for i in range(1,20):
    t=i/19
    freeze=smooth(.11,.94,t)
    late=smooth(.59,1,t)
    # Only a small thermal expansion; the meniscus stays well below the rim.
    rise=1.6*smooth(.42,1,t)
    cy=53.9-rise
    ellipse=1-((x-130.2)/37.1)**2-((y-cy)/8.0)**2
    topmask=smooth(-.085,.085,ellipse)
    front=cy+8*np.sqrt(np.clip(1-((x-130.2)/37.1)**2,0,1))
    bulk=wall*bottommask*smooth(front-.35,front+.5,y)
    liquid=np.maximum(bulk,topmask)

    # Cooling comes from top and sidewalls; the irregular fronts merge last centrally.
    top_rank=(y-front)/53
    side_rank=.07+np.maximum(edge,0)/33*.88
    bottom_rank=.34+(108-y)/54
    arrival=np.minimum(top_rank,np.minimum(side_rank,bottom_rank))
    arrival+=.045*ncoarse+.013*medium
    solid=smooth(arrival-.070,arrival+.07,freeze*.95)*smooth(.08,.23,t)
    # A softly cloudy interior, with less clouding in the outer transparent ice shell.
    core=np.exp(-((x-131.8-.10*(y-81))/15.0)**2)*smooth(64,82,y)
    cloudpattern=np.clip(.51+.23*ncoarse+.13*cloud,0,1)
    opacity=(.32+.27*cloudpattern+.30*core*late)*solid
    opacity*=bulk*(1-preserve)
    tint=np.stack([202+8*cloudpattern,211+7*cloudpattern,215+7*cloudpattern],axis=-1)
    # Broad lighting inherited from the photograph, so ice remains a lit volume.
    tint+=((base.mean(axis=2)-161)*.105)[...,None]
    tint+=(2.9*medium+1.4*fine+2.0*striations)[...,None]
    out=base*(1-opacity[...,None])+tint*opacity[...,None]
    # Tiny ice grain with paired pale and darker refraction fringes.
    crystal=bulk*solid*(.4+.6*(1-core*late))
    out+=(29*veins-14*vein_dark)[...,None]*crystal[...,None]
    out+=(14*bubbles)[...,None]*bulk[...,None]*solid[...,None]*(1-.45*late)

    # A translucent frozen disk first nucleates at the waterline and advances inwards.
    radial=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,((x-130.2)/37.1)**2+((y-cy)/8)**2))
    top_solid=smooth(.95-radial-.1,.95-radial+.12,freeze*1.3)*smooth(.04,.20,t)
    sa=topmask*top_solid*(.42+.27*late)
    st=np.stack([207+5*cloud,217+4*cloud,221+4*cloud],axis=-1)
    st+=(2.0*fine+2*medium)[...,None]
    out=out*(1-sa[...,None])+st*sa[...,None]
    out+=(19*surf_vein)[...,None]*topmask[...,None]*top_solid[...,None]
    # The very thin front boundary of the ice cap has an optical glint.
    lip=np.exp(-((y-front)/.40)**2)*wall*top_solid
    lipshade=np.exp(-((y-front-.65)/.48)**2)*wall*top_solid
    out+=lip[...,None]*np.array([8,10,11])-lipshade[...,None]*np.array([4,4,3])

    # Frost gradually whitens the cold glass, with no moving particles or camera shift.
    frostphase=smooth(.23,.96,t)
    fa=frost_body*frostphase*(.10+.26*frost_grain)*front_frost
    fa*=smooth(.06,.40,solid+.25*smooth(.78,1,t))
    frostcol=np.stack([219+3*medium,225+3*medium,227+3*medium],axis=-1)
    out=out*(1-fa[...,None])+frostcol*fa[...,None]
    # Small extension of the frosty skin above the liquid line, staying off the mouth.
    upper=wall*smooth(46,50,y)*(1-smooth(51,54,y))
    upper*=late*(.04+.075*frost_grain)*(.2+.8*front_frost)
    out=out*(1-upper[...,None])+np.array([217,223,226])*upper[...,None]

    # Changes in the glass are weakly reproduced in its existing tabletop reflection.
    ry=120+(120-y)*.69
    reflected=map_coordinates((out-base).mean(axis=2),[ry*S-.5,x*S-.5],order=1,mode='nearest')
    reflmask=smooth(122,128,y)*(1-smooth(139,145,y))*np.exp(-((x-131)/25)**4)
    out+=np.clip(reflected,0,30)[...,None]*reflmask[...,None]*.15*late
    out=np.clip(out,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    small=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(out).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))

    affect=(liquid+frost_body+upper+reflmask)>.0001

    small=small.copy();small[~affect_small]=base8[~affect_small]
    frames.append(small)

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

specular_band=np.exp(-((x-(left+1.0))/1.05)**2)+.65*np.exp(-((x-(right-1))/1.3)**2)
preserve=np.clip(specular_band*highlight*.40,0,.48)

frames=[base8.copy()]
for i in range(1,20):
    t=i/19
    freeze=smooth(.11,.94,t)
    late=smooth(.59,1,t)
    # Only a small thermal expansion; the meniscus stays well below the rim.
    rise=1.6*smooth(.42,1,t)
    cy=53.9-rise
    ellipse=1-((x-130.2)/37.1)**2-((y-cy)/8.0)**2
    topmask=smooth(-.085,.085,ellipse)
    front=cy+8*np.sqrt(np.clip(1-((x-130.2)/37.1)**2,0,1))
    bulk=wall*bottommask*smooth(front-.35,front+.5,y)
    liquid=np.maximum(bulk,topmask)

    # Cooling comes from top and sidewalls; the irregular fronts merge last centrally.
    top_rank=(y-front)/53
    side_rank=.07+np.maximum(edge,0)/33*.88
    bottom_rank=.34+(108-y)/54
    arrival=np.minimum(top_rank,np.minimum(side_rank,bottom_rank))
    arrival+=.045*ncoarse+.013*medium
    solid=smooth(arrival-.070,arrival+.07,freeze*.95)*smooth(.08,.23,t)
    # A softly cloudy interior, with less clouding in the outer transparent ice shell.
    core=np.exp(-((x-131.8-.10*(y-81))/15.0)**2)*smooth(64,82,y)
    cloudpattern=np.clip(.51+.23*ncoarse+.13*cloud,0,1)
    opacity=(.32+.27*cloudpattern+.30*core*late)*solid
    opacity*=bulk*(1-preserve)
    tint=np.stack([202+8*cloudpattern,211+7*cloudpattern,215+7*cloudpattern],axis=-1)
    # Broad lighting inherited from the photograph, so ice remains a lit volume.
    tint+=((base.mean(axis=2)-161)*.105)[...,None]
    tint+=(2.9*medium+1.4*fine+2.0*striations)[...,None]
    out=base*(1-opacity[...,None])+tint*opacity[...,None]
    # Tiny ice grain with paired pale and darker refraction fringes.
    crystal=bulk*solid*(.4+.6*(1-core*late))
    out+=(29*veins-14*vein_dark)[...,None]*crystal[...,None]
    out+=(14*bubbles)[...,None]*bulk[...,None]*solid[...,None]*(1-.45*late)

    # A translucent frozen disk first nucleates at the waterline and advances inwards.
    radial=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,((x-130.2)/37.1)**2+((y-cy)/8)**2))
    top_solid=smooth(.95-radial-.1,.95-radial+.12,freeze*1.3)*smooth(.04,.20,t)
    sa=topmask*top_solid*(.42+.27*late)
    st=np.stack([207+5*cloud,217+4*cloud,221+4*cloud],axis=-1)
    st+=(2.0*fine+2*medium)[...,None]
    out=out*(1-sa[...,None])+st*sa[...,None]
    out+=(19*surf_vein)[...,None]*topmask[...,None]*top_solid[...,None]
    # The very thin front boundary of the ice cap has an optical glint.
    lip=np.exp(-((y-front)/.40)**2)*wall*top_solid
    lipshade=np.exp(-((y-front-.65)/.48)**2)*wall*top_solid
    out+=lip[...,None]*np.array([8,10,11])-lipshade[...,None]*np.array([4,4,3])

    # Frost gradually whitens the cold glass, with no moving particles or camera shift.
    frostphase=smooth(.23,.96,t)
    fa=frost_body*frostphase*(.10+.26*frost_grain)*front_frost
    fa*=smooth(.06,.40,solid+.25*smooth(.78,1,t))
    frostcol=np.stack([219+3*medium,225+3*medium,227+3*medium],axis=-1)
    out=out*(1-fa[...,None])+frostcol*fa[...,None]
    # Small extension of the frosty skin above the liquid line, staying off the mouth.
    upper=wall*smooth(46,50,y)*(1-smooth(51,54,y))
    upper*=late*(.04+.075*frost_grain)*(.2+.8*front_frost)
    out=out*(1-upper[...,None])+np.array([217,223,226])*upper[...,None]

    # Changes in the glass are weakly reproduced in its existing tabletop reflection.
    ry=120+(120-y)*.69
    reflected=map_coordinates((out-base).mean(axis=2),[ry*S-.5,x*S-.5],order=1,mode='nearest')
    reflmask=smooth(122,128,y)*(1-smooth(139,145,y))*np.exp(-((x-131)/25)**4)
    out+=np.clip(reflected,0,30)[...,None]*reflmask[...,None]*.15*late
    out=np.clip(out,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    small=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(out).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
    # Keep areas unaffected by the glass exactly stable, including the bokeh background.
    affect=(liquid+frost_body+upper+reflmask)>.0001
    affect_small=np.array(Image.fromarray(affect.astype(np.uint8)*255).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.BOX))>0
    small=small.copy();small[~affect_small]=base8[~affect_small]
    frames.append(small)
frames=np.stack(frames).astype(np.uint8)
assert np.array_equal(frames[0],base8)
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
print('Saved',frames.shape,'RGB frames')
